elements.text:
RECALL
During the development of the All-Bank Tech strategy, Technology leadership aligned on consolidating the activities and teams focused on end-user experience and enablement under a single mandate within the GTEP organization. The consolidation commenced in January 2026 with the hiring of Peter Capraro as the VP, Global Employee Digital Experience. Under Peter, WXE’s mandate is to deliver on Initiative C8 (Develop and Implement an Integrated Strategy for All End User Services to Create a Simplified Workplace Experience that Enables Employee Productivity) within the All-Bank Tech Strategy and to support GTEP’s focus on creating Exceptional Colleague Experiences.
KEY POINTS
Context and Current State:
Context: WXE is BNS’ first globally integrated team responsible for engineering and designing workplaces and optimizing colleague productivity and experience. The team designs, engineers, and manages global workplace experiences aimed at elevating our colleagues' productivity, strengthening the Bank’s resilience, and maintaining cost discipline. We aim to deliver this mandate through an integrated operating model (WIP) that elevates engineering rigor and product mgmt philosophy, supported by an intelligence layer (DEX) (see slide 3)
Current State and Case for change: Today, BNS’ endpoint estate does not meet modern requirements and is eroding our colleague's productivity while increasing risk exposure and capital costs. The estate supports ~90k employees with predominantly physical and windows devices (~130K physical devices and ~8K virtual, ~6% virtual), with a relatively high device ratio (1.27). BNS has historically not managed the experience, demand, or cost of the endpoint estate in a centralized mandate, creating a substantial need/opportunity to manage risk and lower capital costs (see slide 4). At the same time, the current estate further amplifies BNS’ exposure to volatile hardware market prices and evolving security threats; meanwhile, peers lead BNS with more virtual, diversified, and dynamically managed estates (see slide 5).
Path Forward:  In response, WXE has defined a go forward mission and 6 strategic priorities aligned to the GTEP and All-Bank Technology Strategy: Deliver a seamless provisioning experience; Curate exceptional colleague offerings; Globalize &  modernize support operations; Enable intelligence & proactive response; Establish a global workplace hardware estate; Win as a global unified team (see slide 6). 
Vision: WXE has developed a clear perspective of what the future of WXE should look and feel like by the end of F28: combining a zero-touch provisioning experience with curated & persona-based workplace offerings and a proactive and globally standardized support operation, which is centrally managed through a DEX intelligence layer (see slide 7). 
Critical Work: We have identified a portfolio of 35 critical work initiatives across our 6 strategic priorities to deliver on WXE’s mandate (see slide 8)
Mobilization: WXE’s leadership team is actively working on defining and orchestrating the detailed milestone roadmap of when and how value will be unlocked for BNS (see slide 9).
Deep Dive - End-User Strategy: The new end-user strategy will shift BNS away from a device-centric model to a segmented, hybrid endpoint strategy driven by DEX. The focus of this work will be to optimize device diversity, introducing a clear persona-based segmentation of our workforce, and building/integrating the critical DEX intelligence layer. (see slide 12)
Optimizing Device Diversity: The new diversified endpoint portfolio (Mac, Cloud PC, Enterprise browser) de-risks the estate and introduces true workspace continuity. (see slide 13)
Introducing Segmentation: Personas will involve distinct physical, virtual, and mobile endpoint postures to better optimize colleague experience, risk, and cost. Specifically, we will deliver fundamentally different workspaces based on the personas' mobility, consistency, and performance needs. (see slide 14 & 15)
Building the Intelligence Layer: It is critical we integrate a DEX system that makes the end‑user strategy observable, controllable, and scalable (see slide 16)
Mobilization: We will be delivering the modern workplace across the Enterprise in phased approaches with key pilots delivered in the U.S. over the next ~3 quarters (see slide 17)
NEXT STEPS
The WXE leadership team is currently articulating the measures of success and detailed strategy roadmap to define the timing of critical milestones (~tentatively wrapped up by early June)
